title: MH HSC Class 12 Chemistry
summary: Maharashtra HSC Class 12 Chemistry board questions, 2014 to 2026, five a day. Questions the board asked again come first, highest count first, then the question types it keeps asking, then every other question.
note: Repeats were found by reading every question of each chapter against the others, across papers (Feb and July of one year are two papers), plus a cross-chapter check. Papers before 2023 come from a chapterwise compilation and are incomplete, so counts for those years are a minimum. Five rows that store a printed question a second time are left out (see excludedQuestions).
